description: Parse raw HTTP response headers (as printed by `curl -I`) and audit them: explains each header, flags risky values (weak CSP, cookies missing Secure/HttpOnly/SameSite, permissive CORS), lists the security headers that are missing, and gives a 0–100 score.

headers.description: Raw response headers, one "Name: value" per line. A status line is ignored.

name: http_headers_analyze
title: Analyse HTTP response headers
